description: This file declares functions, classes, and interfaces related to dialogs in the Wesnoth game, including unit advancement, object objectives, save/load dialogs, unit descriptions, file chooser, and preview panes.

classes.name: dialogs::unit_preview_pane
classes.description: A GUI component for previewing units, with options to show all details or basic info, and to set selection.

classes.name: dialogs::campaign_preview_pane
classes.description: A GUI component for previewing campaign descriptions, allowing selection and display of descriptions.

methods.name: advance_unit
methods.description: Handles advancing a unit, either automatically or via user choice, with optional random selection.

methods.name: animate_unit_advancement
methods.description: Animates the advancement of a unit at a specific location.

methods.name: show_objectives
methods.description: Displays game objectives in a dialog.

methods.name: get_save_name
methods.description: Prompts user to confirm save and enter save name.

methods.name: load_game_dialog
methods.description: Allows user to select a saved game to load.

methods.name: unit_speak
methods.description: Displays a message from a unit.

methods.name: show_file_chooser_dialog
methods.description: Displays a file navigation dialog for user to select a file.

methods.name: unit_preview_pane::show_above
methods.description: Returns whether the preview pane is shown above other UI elements.

methods.name: unit_preview_pane::left_side
methods.description: Returns whether the preview pane is on the left side.

methods.name: unit_preview_pane::set_selection
methods.description: Sets the selected unit index for preview.

methods.name: campaign_preview_pane::show_above
methods.description: Returns whether the campaign preview pane is shown above other UI elements.

methods.name: campaign_preview_pane::left_side
methods.description: Returns whether the campaign preview pane is on the left side.

methods.name: campaign_preview_pane::set_selection
methods.description: Sets the selected description index for preview.
